findings.title: Destructive filesystem or disk operation
findings.message: rm -rf on a path built only from a variable ($d); an empty variable deletes the parent and the script has no set -u
findings.remediation: Quote and validate every path before rm -rf, never recurse on $HOME or / and refuse to run when a variable is empty (set -u, [[ -n $var ]]).

findings.title: Commands run with elevated privileges
findings.message: sudo runs rm (3 occurrences in this file: lines 55, 62, 75)

sudo -n rm -f -- "$f" 2>/dev/null
